input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the main verb “玩.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，“装” does not naturally take an action verb directly in this meaning; “假装” means to pretend to do an action.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，This is the first mention of the main character, so use a brief introduction with the name and a full noun phrase.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the referent has just been named and no other person competes as the main subject.
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，Use 了 for the completed single action of moving house at age five.

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不自然，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达这个意思。
孟子首次出现时需要先作简短介绍，但改后文字以逗号结尾，仍不是完整句子。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按该参考规则应改用近距离回指代词“他”。
五岁时搬家是一次已完成的过去事件，应使用完成体“搬了家”。
